answer: Run a tide audit that no farm can time. A newcomer must lock a 1,700 POA season bond for 120 days, frozen through a full tundra season while every job it does is written into a public ivory ledger anyone can read. Twice a season, at a random hour, auditors pick one past job and demand it be redone live; if the redo fails, or two identities share the same ledger trail, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 170,000 POA. Honest agents ride the tide in and out with their record intact, while a farm's frozen bonds melt away with nothing to show.
